name: Typhoon

npcs.name: Aling Nena
dialogue: A typhoon is coming! Please help me board my windows.
Find the emergency supplies first, then come back to me.
after_dialogue: Thank you, hijo! Now get to the evacuation center.

choice.prompt: Should we board up the windows now? It takes time, and the storm is getting closer.

options.mascot: Good thinking! Boarded windows protect the home, but the storm got closer.
options.consequence: You boarded the windows. It cost time, but the glass stayed intact and the house was protected.

options.text: Skip it and rush to the evacuation center
options.mascot: Saving time helps, but unprotected windows can break in strong wind.
options.consequence: You skipped the windows. You saved time, but strong wind broke the glass and damaged the house.

mascot.intro: Hi, I'm Tarsi! A typhoon is coming. Check the quest list at the top right. Press H if you need a hint!

quests.supplies: Look for the green go-bag. Every family needs one ready for an emergency.
quests.flashlight: A flashlight is important when the power goes out. Look for the yellow item.
quests.talk_nena: Aling Nena needs help. Walk up to the orange person and press E.
quests.evac: Head to the blue Evacuation Center in the bottom-right corner.

lessons: Prepare a go-bag with water, food, a flashlight, a radio, first aid and documents before a storm.
Follow PAGASA warnings and evacuate early when local officials tell you to.
Stay away from flooded areas and falling objects. Never wade through floodwater.
Keep a battery-powered radio and charged phone for updates when the power goes out.
